# relay_database_user (Resource)

An engine-level user on a managed database. Roles, databases and the auth method cannot change in place; changing them replaces the user. `description`, `connection_limit` and `statement_timeout` can be changed but not cleared.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "relay_database_user" "app" {
  workspace_id      = relay_database.billing.workspace_id
  database_id       = relay_database.billing.id
  username          = "app"
  generate_password = true
  roles             = [{ role = "readWrite", db = "billing" }]
  connection_limit  = 50
}

output "app_password" {
  value     = relay_database_user.app.generated_password
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) Managed database ID.
- `roles` (Attributes List) Roles granted to the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `username` (String) Engine username.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace of the database.

### Optional

- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method. Only `password` is supported.
- `connection_limit` (Number) Maximum concurrent connections.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 expiry. Removing it makes the user permanent.
- `generate_password` (Boolean) Let the platform generate the password. It is returned once in `generated_password`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password. Write-only on the API: changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `restricted_resources` (List of String) Resources the user is restricted to.
- `statement_timeout` (String) Statement timeout, for example `30s`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `generated_password` (String, Sensitive) Generated password, stored in state. Not recoverable from the API.
- `id` (String) `<database_id>/<username>`.
- `phase` (String) Reconcile phase.
- `phase_message` (String) Detail for the phase.
- `stale` (Boolean) Whether the platform considers the user stale.

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Required:

- `role` (String) Role name, for example `readOnly` or `readWrite`.

Optional:

- `collection` (String) MongoDB collection the role applies to.
- `db` (String) Database the role applies to.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import relay_database_user.app <workspace_id>/<database_id>/<username>
```
